description: This document provides a detailed low-level design for the 'Leads' module of vtiger CRM, covering architecture, database schema, class responsibilities, workflows, webservice interactions, and internal logic for CRUD, conversions, relations, and duplicate management. It describes core classes (`CRMEntity`, `Leads`, `ConvertLeadUI`), key database tables and relations, and the sequence of operations for save, convert, list, merge, mass edit, and delete.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class providing persistence, event triggers, and relationship management for all entity modules, including Leads.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: Module-specific class extending CRMEntity with metadata, relation overrides, and lead-related list/query functions.

classes.name: ConvertLeadUI
classes.description: Helper class for loading lead info, permissions, and default field values during the lead conversion UI process.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the module class.

methods.name: CRMEntity::retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Loads entity data from respective tables into a property array.

methods.name: CRMEntity::save
methods.description: Triggers save workflows and calls saveentity() to persist data.

methods.name: CRMEntity::saveentity
methods.description: Performs the actual DB inserts/updates for the entity's main tables.

methods.name: Leads::create_export_query
methods.description: Builds SQL for exporting lead data, enforcing access control and filtering unconverted leads.

methods.name: Leads::get_activities
methods.description: Fetches open activities associated with a lead.

methods.name: Leads::get_campaigns
methods.description: Lists campaigns related to a lead.

methods.name: Leads::transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records (activities, notes, products, etc.) from multiple leads to a target lead during merge.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::__construct
methods.description: Loads lead data and permissions for the conversion UI.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::getLeadInfo
methods.description: Fetches all details of a lead for display in conversion.

methods.name: ConvertLeadUI::setAssignedToInfo
methods.description: Sets default owner selection info (user/group) for the conversion form.

methods.name: vtws_convertlead
methods.description: Webservice function orchestrating the leading conversion process, creating account/contact/potential and transferring relations.

methods.name: vtws_transferLeadRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers all related activities, notes, products, and relations from a lead to a newly created or existing entity.
